newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bouygues to float Offshore unit in '96.
newsitem.headline: Bouygues to float Offshore unit in '96.

text.p: French construction company Bouygues said on Monday it would bring its Bouygues Offshore subsidiary to the French and U.S. stock market by the end of the year.

Bouygues said in a newspaper advertisement it had started issue proceedings with the French and U.S. market authorities and that the final calendar and the transaction would depend, among other things, on market conditions and official approval.
The offshore unit specialises in the offshore and onshore oil industry, including industrial maintenance, marine work and transport of liquified gas.
Bouygues Offshore had 1995 turnover of 3.4 billion francs and first-half sales this year of 1.8 billion francs.
